title: Quick Ugali with K and Maize
description: A simple and traditional East African dish made with quick ugali and topped with k and maize.
instructions: Boil 2 cups of water in a large pot.
Add 1 cup of quick ugali flour and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the mixture thickens.
Transfer the ugali to a serving plate.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of chopped k and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Add 1 cup of grated maize and cook for another 2 minutes.
Serve the k and maize mixture on top of the ugali.
